context: A built howdy skill turns verified answers into exact per-source calls and a four-part brief, and treats every source that failed or was never checked as unverified instead of writing it as working. Judge skills/howdy/SKILL.md, any files beside it, and response.md.

checklist.name: Failed and unchecked sources flagged
checklist.description: Google Calendar, which returned a 403 scope error, and Jira through the Atlassian MCP, which probes.md never checked, are both named to the user as not verified, with a next step (re-auth or check, keep, or drop). Neither is presented as a working source without that marking. Missing either one scores at most 10

checklist.name: Exact call per source
checklist.description: The skill gives, for each verified source, the exact command or MCP tool taken from probes.md: gh search with --owner=acme --owner=acme-labs, gog gmail search with the account, and the Slack MCP's slack_search_messages tool. Generic descriptions such as 'check GitHub' score at most 6

checklist.name: Four-part brief
checklist.description: The skill's brief has Needs you, This week, In flight, and Since last time sections, and Needs you uses the user's own definition from answers.md

checklist.name: Read-only sweep
checklist.description: The skill's sweep only reads: no posting (slack_post_message is not used), no marking mail read. A source that fails during a run becomes one line in the brief and the sweep continues

checklist.name: Lanes on a board
checklist.description: Because the user runs agent lanes, the skill shows lane state as a table or diagram board in or beside Needs you, with lanes waiting on the user surfaced

checklist.name: Skill shape
checklist.description: skills/howdy/SKILL.md has frontmatter with name howdy and a description that says what it does and when to use it, and the steps end in a checkable done condition, such as every source landing in a section or named as failed

checklist.name: Maintenance path
checklist.description: The skill or reply says how to keep it current when a source dies, a tool is renamed, or repos change: re-check sources and update the skill in place
